name: PingCastle
what: A tool that scores the security risk of an Active Directory domain and produces a health-check report with findings and a maturity level. It also offers an Entra ID risk score.
when: For a quick, repeatable AD health check, and to track the risk score over time as you fix findings.
license: Non-Profit OSL 3.0 (open source edition) or commercial
cost_note: Free for internal use, including in for-profit companies; a commercial license is needed to sell PingCastle-based services or products.
example: Download PingCastle from the official site to a domain-joined admin workstation.
Start it and choose the healthcheck option from the interactive menu, then accept or enter the domain.
Open the HTML report; begin with the rules that carry the highest points.
Fix, re-run and compare the score; keep reports to show progress.
pitfalls: Using it to deliver paid audits for other organizations needs a commercial license.
The score drops slowly when one big rule dominates; read each rule's detail.
Reports list sensitive accounts and weaknesses; store them like secrets.
